parse.title: RuneScape:WikiSync
parse.wikitext: {{external|rs}}{{Shortcut|RS:WS|RS:SYNC}} '''WikiSync''' is a [[RuneLite]] and [[HDOS]] plugin that uploads your ''Old School RuneScape'' character's quest completion, [[Achievement Diary]] task completion, skill levels, and [[Leagues]] task status to a server run by the Old School RuneScape Wiki. This data is then used by various articles on the wiki in order to personalise the content for your character, including on quest requirement displays and the [[Trailblazer Reloaded League/Tasks|League tasks pages]] for completion percentages. In the future, this may extend to other use cases. Similar to the official HiScores, this data about your character can be viewed by anyone, and is not private. We don't suggest using this if you are (for example) a PvP-locked hardcore ironman, where broadcasting your quest status could be detrimental to your account, by giving away information about what you're currently doing. You can view the public source code for the plugin in [https://github.com/weirdgloop/WikiSync this GitHub repository]. ==Installing WikiSync== [[File:WikiSync plugin search.png|200px|left]] [[File:HDOS wikisync search.png|thumb|Enabling WikiSync in HDOS]] For RuneLite users, the WikiSync plugin can be downloaded from RuneLite's plugin-hub. See [https://github.com/runelite/runelite/wiki/Information-about-the-Plugin-Hub RuneLite's documentation] for how to use the plugin-hub. Once you have downloaded the plugin, make sure it is toggled on! It is called "WikiSync" in the settings panel. For HDOS users, the plugin can be enabled from the plugin settings panel found in the sidebar. {{clear}} ==Using WikiSync== If the plugin is on, your data should be uploaded when you first log in. After that, data will be pushed up as it gets updated. You shouldn't need to do anything other than play the game, with the exception of syncing your collection log. You can use WikiSync on the wiki in a number of places. ===Quest pages=== Quest pages have an input box on the quest requirements section. Enter your username there, and then click "Look up". The quest and skill requirements should then be checked off if you have them done, and given a red X if you do not. Keep in mind that this won't account for boostable requirements! [[File:WikiSync plugin example.png|380px|center|thumb|Quest requirements checked off]] {{Clear}} ===Collection log=== In order to sync your collection log data, you need to go into the collection log interface and press the "WikiSync" button in the top right. Your data can then be seen on [[Collection log/Table|the collection log table here]]. [[File:WikiSync collection log example.png|400px|center|thumb|The WikiSync button in the Collection log interface.]] ===DPS calculator=== The [https://dps.osrs.wiki OSRS Wiki DPS Calculator] supports loading your player data live from a '''running RuneLite client with WikiSync installed on the same machine'''. To use this integration, click the RuneLite button next to your loadout name on the calculator. [[File:Information icon.svg|20px]] '''Note:''' Your browser may prompt you to allow ''tools.runescape.wiki'' to "access other apps and services" on your device. This is because the calculator communicates with your RuneLite client by making a request to an endpoint running on your local machine as part of the WikiSync plugin. You must grant this permission to use the feature. We do not store any data from your device, and we do not make requests to any app except RuneLite. ===Other data collected by WikiSync=== * Music track unlocks * Achievement diaries * Combat achievements * Sea charting unlocks * Skill levels ==Troubleshooting== {{Shortcut|RS:WSHELP}} If it seems like WikiSync is not working for you, please try the following: # Make sure you are using RuneLite. # Make sure that the WikiSync plugin is turned ON in your settings. # If playing an alternative mode like Leagues, log in to one of those worlds with the plugin ON. # Make sure that your current player name in the WikiSync input box is correct. # Try either clearing your cookies or going into incognito mode on your browser, then try to input your current player name in the WikiSync input. # Ensure that your browser is not blocking the script or the connection to WikiSync. If using our DPS calculator, you may need to allow WebSocket connections. #* For Brave browser, disable [https://support.brave.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023646212-How-do-I-configure-global-and-site-specific-Shields-settings Brave Shields] on our site. # If you are using uBlock Origin and have the default filter list "Block Outsider Intrusions Into LAN" enabled, try adding "oldschool.runescape.wiki" and "tools.runescape.wiki" to the "Trusted sites" section of the uBlock Origin settings. # If none of the following fix the issue, try toggling the WikiSync plugin to OFF and then back ON. # If none of the following fix the issue, remove the WikiSync plugin from RuneLite and then redownload it from the plugin hub (see [[#Installing WikiSync]]). # Finally, try restarting your RuneLite client. # If none of the following steps help, feel free to join [https://discord.gg/HWhxYsP the RuneScape Wikis Discord] and ping @andmcadams for help ==Hiding WikiSync Option== [[File:Disabling WikiSync gadget.png|300px|left|thumb|Wiki Preferences, showing the WikiSync button]] If you would like to hide the WikiSync gadget, visit [[Special:Preferences]], then go to the "Gadgets" tab and deselect the WikiSync button. This requires a wiki account. [[Category:Old School RuneScape Wiki community]] {{Clear}} ==Third-party use== The WikiSync plugin and the associated API is intended for use by the wiki, and not by third-party developers. While we love seeing what cool projects people can make with data from the wiki, people who enable the plugin are choosing to share their game data to improve their experience on the wiki, rather than arbitrary third-parties. '''Please do not use the WikiSync API in your own projects'''. We will be actively taking steps to limit the usage of our API outside of our own websites.
